summary: Describes F-RTO, a sender-only algorithm for detecting spurious retransmission timeouts in TCP and SCTP. A spurious timeout causes unnecessary resending of data, which hurts performance. F-RTO needs no TCP options. The document is experimental.

eli5.summary: Sometimes you think a letter is lost and send another, but the first one was just slow. This memo helps computers notice that mistake so they do not waste time sending things twice.
